verdict.rationale: Pika documents an API offering ('Pika API Club: One API for 100+ leading video, image, audio, and LLM models') and an MCP server, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence mentions API versioning, version pinning, or a deprecation policy. An API existing is adjacent to this story and does not deliver it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
